title: China Adventure
name: China Adventure
p1: Eight days among the sandstone pillars of Zhangjiajie and the ancient towns of Furong and Fenghuang. Ride the Bailong Glass Elevator, cross the Glass Bridge, take the Tianmen Mountain cable car to Heaven’s Gate, and cruise the Tuojiang River at dusk.
p2: Your flight, accommodations, excursions, transportation and breakfasts are included, with group airport transfers on arrival and departure. A welcome dinner opens the trip and a farewell dinner closes it.
presImg: Pavilions along the water at Baofeng Lake
presText: Spend a full day in the Wulingyuan UNESCO park, glide across Baofeng Lake by boat, and stand at Heaven’s Gate on Tianmen Mountain. In Fenghuang, join a Miao batik workshop before your farewell dinner.
